title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: Oblique view from the patient's head and right side looking toward the feet (NYSORA's camera): chest and nipple toward the top, clavicle across the lower third, shoulder at the left, neck at the lower right.
teachingPoint: Probe sagittal in the infraclavicular fossa; needle in just above (behind) the clavicle, directly cranial to the probe, aimed caudally, strictly in-plane.
claims: Supine, arm adducted (record); oblique view after NYSORA's infraclavicular patient photo (owner, 2026-10-02; concept only).
Linear probe standing upright, sagittal, on the infraclavicular fossa below the lateral third of the clavicle (record).
Needle entering just above the clavicle, cranial to the probe and in line with it, aimed caudally under the clavicle (record: posterior to the clavicle, caudal, strictly in-plane).
Labels: Clavicle, Linear probe, Block needle.
